sentences.text: If you shine invisible waves at food, you have a microwave oven.
But the waves heat one side, and the other side stays cold.
So you add a turntable that spins the food through the waves.
But now the waves leak out of the open front.
So you add a door with a metal mesh whose holes are far smaller than the waves.
The waves shake water in the food 2.45 billion times a second.
And it does not cook from the inside out.
The waves reach just 1 to 1.5 inches, and heat creeps inward inch by inch.
Add a keypad, a timer and a light.
Congratulations, you have built a microwave oven.
